_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county_name.label: County Name
county_name.expects: a Maine county name (the form prints 'COUNTY'/'Probate Court'); rendered upper-case, without the word 'County'
avoid: a person or court name
the trailing word 'County'

docket_number.label: Docket Number
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

estate_decedent_name.label: Estate Decedent Name
estate_decedent_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: initials or nicknames
a title with no name
'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

decedent_death_date.label: Decedent Death Date
avoid: vague text like 'last spring' or 'unknown'
an impossible/!calendar date
a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields
a date in the future

real_estate_maine.label: Real Estate Maine
real_estate_maine.expects: a dollar amount, digits and decimal point only
avoid: a '$' character inside the value (the form prints it)
thousands separators or words
a negative amount unless this line is explicitly a credit
